strategy_roster.name: Fisher Org Signal
strategy_roster.notes: The Fisher Transform is not a DSL function, so the oscillator is approximated by the z-score of close over the documented Fisher Length=7, with UpLevel=1.5 and DownLevel=-1.5 read in those standardized units. The documented opposite cross reverses the position and the docs specify no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Caudate X Period Candle TM Plus
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_low(low,20) and close < (donchian_high(high,20) + donchian_low(low,20)) / 2
strategy_roster.notes: The six-colour classifier needs a smoothed OHLC range and per-bar body ranking that the DSL cannot reproduce, so the bullish lower-tail colours (0/1) are approximated by a bullish body in the lower half of the 20-bar Donchian range, with the bearish upper-tail group as the exit. Donchian Period=20 and MA Length=10 are fallbacks; the Signal Bar delay, time exit, and point stop/target are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Exp i-KlPrice Vol Direct
strategy_roster.notes: The KlPrice oscillator and the final Jurik filter cannot be rebuilt, so the documented chain is approximated by an EMA spread normalised by ATR(14) and weighted by volume_ratio(20), and the documented slope-sign flip drives the trades. All periods are fallbacks since the docs list no values, and the SignalBar delay and tick-versus-real volume choice are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Envelope Limit Ladder
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= ema(close,144) and close > ema(close,144) * 0.9995 and close > ema(close,144)
strategy_roster.notes: EnvelopePeriod=144 and the 0.05% bands are exact, but that envelope is narrower than the daily tick resolution, so the documented midline buy-limit fill (low at the midline with the close back above it) carries the signal while the bands gate the stop and target. The three-rung ladder with 8/13/21-point targets, the separate envelope timeframe, the 0-17 hour window, and the trailing-to-MA option are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: AI SuperTrend
strategy_roster.notes: The SuperTrend flip is proxied by a 10-bar channel break (AtrPeriod=10) and the two WMA legs are approximated by SMA(close,20) above SMA(close,100) with the documented PriceWmaLength and SuperWmaLength. The ATR(10) x 3 trailing stop is a dynamic price distance, so both percent fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: TradingViewTo Strategy Template With Dynamic Alerts
strategy_roster.notes: The documented defaults are all used exactly: RSI(14) above UpperLevel=60 opens the long, the 40 LowerLevel closes it, and StopLossPct=2m/TakeProfitPct=4m become the 2.0 and 4.0 percent fields. The 1-minute candle type and the dynamic alert notifications are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Open Close2 Ampn Stochastic
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9) > 0 and close > open and roc(close,1) > 0 and crossabove(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,9)) / (donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9)),3), sma(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,9)) / (donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9)),3),3))
strategy_roster.exit_long: donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9) > 0 and crossbelow(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,9)) / (donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9)),3), sma(sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,9)) / (donchian_high(high,9) - donchian_low(low,9)),3),3))
strategy_roster.notes: StochasticLength=9 with the documented 3/3 %K and %D smoothing is exact, and the two-bar price filter is rendered as a bullish current bar continuing the prior up close, with a non-zero range guard. The risk-based sizing, MaximumRisk drawdown guard, DecreaseFactor volume reduction, and MinimumVolume floor are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: MA Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.entry_long: std(close,20) > 0 and (close - sma(close,20)) / std(close,20) < -2.0 and roc(close - sma(close,20),1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: The swing from the mean is the 20-bar z-score of price against MaPeriod=20, ThresholdMultiplier=2.0 sets the extreme, and a rising deviation is the documented turn back toward the mean, with the mean itself as the exit. StopLossPercent=2m becomes the 2.0 percent stop; the 5-minute series is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Turn of the Month Strategy Honestcowboy
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy is purely calendar driven (long DaysBeforeEnd=2 into month end, close DaysAfterStart=3 into the new month) with Indicators: None, and the DSL has no date or clock fields, so the never-true guard is used instead of a fabricated signal. No stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Customizable BTC Seasonality
strategy_roster.notes: Entries and exits are fixed UTC hours (EntryHour=21, ExitHour=23) with Indicators: None, which is a time-only schedule the daily DSL cannot express, so the never-true guard is used. The 1-minute clock candles and the absence of stops are outside the DSL.
